text: Upgrade the SSO Gateway TLS library to 3.2. Tested in staging with full login regression. Rollback: redeploy previous container image.
Patch the nightly jobs runner to fix the timezone bug. Deploy Sunday 02:00. No rollback plan yet, to be defined.
Change invoice rounding logic in the invoicing service. Unit tests pass. Rollback via feature flag.
Increase the connection pool on the customer database. Applied in production during business hours. No testing done.
Extend audit log retention config from 90 to 365 days. Tested in dev. Revert by restoring the config.
Move the email service to a new SMTP relay. Smoke test in staging passed. Rollback: switch the relay back via DNS.
Replace the card processing endpoint URLs and rotate keys. Tested with sandbox transactions. No rollback documented.
Add a department attribute to the user directory schema and adjust the single sign-on claims mapping to include it. Tested end to end in UAT. Rollback: restore schema snapshot.
Add a region column to the data warehouse fact table. Regression tested in the test environment; rollback script attached.
Hotfix for the back-office portal permissions screen. Rolled out straight to production, we will watch the logs.
Decommission the old file store bucket after migrating contracts. Migration verified by checksum. Rollback: bucket retained for 30 days.
Change how the thing that sends customers their receipts batches messages, from 100 to 500 per run. Tested in staging, can be reverted by config.
Rewrite the customer lookup queries in the CRM database for performance. Staging benchmark attached. Rollback plan: keep the old indexes.
Update the iOS app login flow to use the new token format; the login service must accept the new token too. Tested on devices. Rollback: previous app version stays available.
Shift the end-of-day processing window from 23:00 to 22:00 so overnight reconciliation finishes earlier. Confirmed with operations, test run in staging, can revert the schedule.
Rotate service credentials for everything that talks to payments and customer records, during the weekend. Tested rotation in staging. Rollback: previous credentials valid for 24h.
Switch the login page to the new brand theme. Visual check done. No functional change.
